name: What kind of maintenance does custom trim require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does custom trim require?

acceptedAnswer.text: The maintenance required for custom trim largely depends on the material and finish. Painted wood trim typically requires occasional cleaning with a damp cloth and touch-ups of paint if scuffed or chipped over time. Stained wood trim may benefit from periodic re-application of protective sealants or waxes to maintain its luster. PVC and composite trims are generally low-maintenance, needing only occasional cleaning. Regardless of the material, avoiding harsh chemical cleaners and promptly addressing any damage will help preserve the trim's appearance and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance varies by material: painted wood needs occasional cleaning and touch-ups, stained wood may need resealing, and PVC/composite trims require minimal cleaning.
